in_marathi.name: Archi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Architect of own destiny
in_marathi.long_meaning: Archi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Archi means 'architect'. This name is bestowed upon a girl who is destined to shape her own future and build a life of her dreams. Inspired by the goddess Shakti, Archi embodies strength, creativity, and determination. Her name signifies the power to create and manifest one's desires.
